methods.title: What buying more entries covers
methods.summary: Each Lotto entry is compared with the drawing on its own.
methods.limitation: More entries is more chances at the published odds. It does not change how the drawing is conducted.

methods.title: Setting a fixed entertainment budget
methods.summary: Deciding an amount before you play, and treating it as the cost of entertainment, keeps play in proportion.
methods.limitation: No budget or number of entries changes the outcome of a drawing.
